nodes.title: How to use this workflow
widgets_values:
## Use your own layout

Load a blocking render in **Load video** and an image of the look you want in **Look image**, then describe the shot in **Prompt**. **Shorter side** is the final size, keeping the layout's shape; the first stage renders at half. **Max seconds** cuts longer clips.

**Needs** ComfyUI 0.37 or newer (frontend 1.53 or newer) and ComfyUI-LTXVideo at commit 3bf3ca6 or newer. If any node shows up red, here or inside a subgraph, update ComfyUI or the LTXVideo pack rather than rewiring the graph.
